ModMetaData.name: Hardcore Freezers
ModMetaData.author: Sk
ModMetaData.description: Frozen perishables spoil gradually, with colder storage slowing spoilage until a configurable deep-freeze cutoff stops it. Both temperature curves apply to food, corpses, herbal medicine, and other perishables that use Rimworld's rot component. The optional freeze-damage curve makes perishables lose hit points in extreme cold. Customize both curves in the mod settings.
